crossRefs.note: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

translations.web: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
translations.bsb: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
